instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign the ESG Records Tracker row and expanded panel using JavaScript (.js) components matching the mockup requirements.

Implement the category row with checkbox, expand chevron, assignee avatar+name+email, approver avatar+name, due date with days remaining, progress bar + text, and 3 status count chips (Completed green check, Awaiting approval blue clock, Pending grey circle).
Implement the subcategory row on stone-100/60 background with assignee, approver pill + dashed add button, due date, progress bar, status badge pill, bell button, and rounded toggle.

Implement the expanded rounded card panel with hierarchy headers (muted parent / bold child), metadata subtitle, FY pill button, and 4 working tabs: Periods, Assignment and approvers, Activity, Linked disclosures.

In the Periods tab, render 4 period cards (e.g. Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4) showing period status pills, date ranges, bold due dates, hairline divider, and context lines ('Approved by... View submitted data', 'Submitted by...', 'Collection opens...'). Highlight the awaiting card with blue border outline.
Render the status legend at the bottom of the panel with Completed, Awaiting approval, Pending, and Overdue dots.
Omit interactive Approve / Send Back buttons in period cards per user choices (display only).
Ensure all interactive elements have kebab-case data-testid attributes for testing.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.theme: Organic Stone / Emerald ESG Design System
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop: Avoid generic Vercel dark themes or plain unstyled white boxes. Use rich stone-50 backgrounds with crisp stone-200 borders, emerald accents, and clear typography hierarchy.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.interactive_elements: Include subtle hover and focus states for all buttons and toggles without using 'transition: all'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing: All interactive buttons, tabs, chips, and links MUST include exact data-testid attributes as defined.
